# Cardiff & Caerphilly Group

> Five specialist home-improvement trades in South Wales that work together as one local team: construction, carpentry, electricians, plumbers and landscaping. Based in Cardiff and Caerphilly, also covering Penarth, Barry, Newport and Pontypridd. Free quotes; 24-hour emergency plumbing call-out.

## Contact

- WhatsApp any trade: 07545 514746
- Call direct: 07803 083422
- 24hr emergency call-out: 029 2169 0437
- Website: https://www.cardiffandcaerphillygroup.co.uk/

## The five trades

- [Cardiff & Caerphilly Construction](https://www.cardiffandcaerphillyconstruction.co.uk/): house extensions, loft conversions, renovations, kitchen fitting. Phone 029 2169 0523.
- [Cardiff & Caerphilly Carpentry](https://www.cardiffandcaerphillycarpentry.com/): fitted wardrobes, media walls, alcove and under-stairs storage. Phone 07803 083422.
- [Cardiff & Caerphilly Electricians](https://www.cardiff-electricians.co.uk/): rewires, EICRs, consumer units, EV charger installation, lighting. Phone 029 2169 0502.
- [Cardiff & Caerphilly Plumbers](https://www.cardiffandcaerphillyplumbers.com/): emergency plumbing, leaks, boiler repair and installation, bathrooms. Phone 029 2169 0437.
- [Cardiff & Caerphilly Landscaping](https://www.cardiffandcaerphillylandscaping.co.uk/): patios, fencing, garden design, garden rooms. Phone 029 2169 0507.

## How it works

Small jobs go straight to the one trade that specialises in them. Bigger projects (extensions, kitchens, loft conversions) are planned across the trades in the right order, so the customer deals with one joined-up team.
